diagrams.title: From B2B pain signal to sticky recurring MRR
diagrams.subtitle: Five-stage vertical AI micro-SaaS execution loop
diagrams.assumptions_note: Numeric values indicate engineering and GTM sequence, not guaranteed retention.
diagrams.caption: Anchor the software around a system-of-work bottleneck and proprietary context rather than an exposed single-prompt wrapper.

stages.label: Isolate B2B wedge
stages.detail: Mine technographic churn, G2 1-star complaints, and compliance defects; secure paid pilot LOIs first.

stages.label: Ingest domain context
stages.detail: Normalize public registries or tenant documents behind Postgres Row-Level Security and pgvector.

stages.label: Route & cache tokens
stages.detail: Dispatch 85% routine tasks to small models, 15% synthesis to frontier models, with semantic caching.

stages.label: Deliver <5m value
stages.detail: Ship a pre-loaded diagnostic artifact or workflow copilot output in the user's first session.

stages.label: Expand NRR
stages.detail: Compound revenue via metered workflow credits, team seats, embedded VCC rails, and smart dunning.

diagrams.title: Diagnostic scanner outbound to retained B2B logos
diagrams.subtitle: Illustrative cohort of 1,000 scanned B2B domains
diagrams.assumptions_note: Invented nested cohort counts illustrating outbound/PLG conversion math; actual rates vary by vertical.
diagrams.caption: Automated compliance, technographic, and migration scanners convert cold outbound into concrete product demos.

stages.label: Domains scanned
stages.detail: Automated WCAG, SSL, DNS technographic, or incumbent-pricing scans across qualified B2B domains.

stages.label: Verified defect hits
stages.detail: Prospects with a documented compliance gap, renewal window, or broken workflow.

stages.label: Interactive trials
stages.detail: Decision-makers inspecting their pre-populated diagnostic workspace or calculator.

stages.label: Paying MRR logos
stages.detail: Self-serve or founder-assisted conversions onto a $149-$299/mo hybrid subscription.

stages.label: Expanded annual logos
stages.detail: Accounts upgrading to annual prepay, extra seats, or higher metered credit tiers.

diagrams.title: Monthly ARPU to net owner operating margin
diagrams.subtitle: Illustrative $150/mo B2B account on unsubsidized compute
diagrams.assumptions_note: USD per $150 monthly subscription receipt; opening and closing bars are totals, middle bars are deductions.
diagrams.caption: Even after startup cloud credits expire, model routing and semantic caching preserve >80% SaaS gross margin and 30%-45% net margin.

stages.label: Monthly ARPU
stages.detail: Hybrid $99 base workspace plus $51 average metered workflow and seat expansion.

stages.label: LLM & vector compute
stages.detail: Unsubsidized tiered model inference, embeddings, and managed Postgres/queue allocation.

stages.label: Billing & tax rail
stages.detail: Stripe Billing + Tax or Merchant-of-Record processing and failed-card retry overhead.

stages.label: Churn & refund drag
stages.detail: Amortized involuntary/voluntary churn and prorated ROSCA cancellation credits.

stages.label: Contractor & GTM pod
stages.detail: Allocated part-time engineering, support automation, and acquisition spend at scale.

stages.label: Owner net contribution
stages.detail: 45% scaled small-team owner margin before personal income taxes and R&D tax timing.

diagrams.title: Effective take-rate across SaaS billing architectures
diagrams.subtitle: Illustrative % fee on a $150/mo B2B subscription
diagrams.assumptions_note: Percent of a $150 SaaS charge; excludes state CPA filing fees if managing multi-jurisdiction sales tax directly.
diagrams.caption: Match the billing rail to buyer geography: MoR eliminates global VAT filings early, while Stripe Billing + ACH optimizes high-ACV B2B.

stages.label: Stripe ACH / Wire
stages.detail: Capped ACH debit ideal for $1,500-$5,000 annual B2B prepay invoices.

stages.label: Stripe Card + Tax
stages.detail: 2.9% + $0.30 card processing plus ~0.5% Stripe Tax calculation; seller remits state/VAT returns.

stages.label: MoR (Paddle / LS)
stages.detail: 5% + $0.50 Merchant-of-Record fee absorbing global SaaS VAT, US Wayfair nexus, and chargebacks.

stages.label: App Store In-App
stages.detail: Default mobile store cut (15% Small Business tier) avoided via Web2App external web checkout.

diagrams.title: Inference cost, security & involuntary-churn guardrails
diagrams.subtitle: Mandatory production checks before opening public signups
diagrams.assumptions_note: Numbers identify engineering gates; enforce in middleware before any upstream LLM call.
diagrams.caption: Prevent weekend token-bill blowups and cross-tenant leaks through hard Redis budgets, RLS isolation, ZDR endpoints, and smart dunning.

stages.label: Tenant RLS & cap?
stages.detail: Enforce Postgres tenant_id RLS and hard daily/monthly Redis token ceilings before inference.

stages.label: Cache or small model?
stages.detail: Serve repeat queries from cache and route structured extraction to low-cost models first.

stages.label: ZDR & eval pass?
stages.detail: Call Zero-Data-Retention enterprise endpoints and block deploys that regress golden evals.

stages.label: Smart dunning live?
stages.detail: Run card-updater, pre-expiry alerts, and multi-day retry cadences to cut involuntary churn.

diagrams.title: One full-time founder, two specialized contractors
diagrams.subtitle: Illustrative 3-person ($375k ARR Base Case) SaaS pod
diagrams.assumptions_note: Numeric values are role identifiers; Scaled ($700k ARR) scenario expands to 2 FT + 3 C.
diagrams.caption: Keep headcount ultra-lean by automating CI evals, onboarding, and Tier-1 docs deflection before hiring full-time staff.

stages.label: Founder / product lead
stages.detail: Owns customer discovery, core architecture, pricing, enterprise trust, and capital allocation.

stages.label: Full-stack & eval dev
stages.detail: Maintains connectors, RLS migrations, golden-dataset evals, and companion extension releases.

stages.label: Growth & CS specialist
stages.detail: Runs diagnostic-scanner outbound, comparison calculators, onboarding calls, and churn-save reviews.

diagrams.title: Disciplined $15,000 bootstrapped AI micro-SaaS budget
diagrams.subtitle: Illustrative launch stack paired with cloud/LLM credit grants
diagrams.assumptions_note: USD cash outlay; excludes non-cash AWS/GCP/Azure/LLM startup credits that subsidize early compute.
diagrams.caption: Cloud credit grants subsidize inference COGS, not founder runway; keep >=50% of cash in liquid reserve until MRR covers fixed opex.

stages.label: Entity, IP & DPA setup
stages.detail: LLC/C-corp formation, banking, contractor IP assignment templates, and baseline privacy/DPA docs.

stages.label: Core infra & telemetry
stages.detail: Domains, managed Postgres/auth/observability tiers, and golden-eval testing harness.

stages.label: Scanner & GTM pilots
stages.detail: Technographic/WCAG scanner infra, comparison-page assets, and bounded paid-search intent tests.

stages.label: Liquid runway reserve
stages.detail: Untouched cash buffer protecting against slow B2B sales cycles and credit-grant expiration.

diagrams.title: Thirty days from buyer interviews to first 10 MRR logos
diagrams.subtitle: Four weekly validation, multi-tenant build, outbound & retention gates
diagrams.assumptions_note: Numeric values are milestone end-days; full 2-9 month ramp applies to stabilized recurring cohorts.
diagrams.caption: Never spend three months coding in isolation: validate paid pilot commitments in Week 1 and ship a metered multi-tenant wedge by Day 14.

stages.label: Validate & pre-sell
stages.detail: Mine G2/technographic pain, interview 15 buyers, demo clickable scan, and lock >=3 paid pilot LOIs.

stages.label: Ship metered MVP
stages.detail: Deploy Postgres RLS, ZDR model router, Redis token caps, semantic cache, and Stripe hybrid billing.

stages.label: Launch scanner GTM
stages.detail: Activate pilot logos in <5 minutes, run WCAG/churn-scanner outbound, and publish vs-incumbent pages.

stages.label: Audit NRR & scale
stages.detail: Audit unsubsidized token margin per tenant, enable smart dunning, and apply Day-30 Kill/Scale rules.
